userDecision.instruction: Prepare only. Do not assign the historical 52M to IT or change historical data.

purpose: Recruiter-facing FlowRequest Demo; no automatic database writes

openingBalanceChoicesForReview.condition: Only if the user confirms the historical 52M belongs to IT and approves a reconciled opening balance. It does not authorize edits to the original request or payment.
Only if the user explicitly defines this as a new Demo allocation excluding the historical 52M. Historical commitment remains separately disclosed; this is not a full historical reconciliation.

historicalPolicy.note: Historical department linkage is a separate approval and migration decision; it is not performed by this proposal.

applicationPlan.phase1: Confirm allocation and opening commitment explicitly; null is not zero. Do not create a budget until approved.
applicationPlan.phase2: After approval, Accountant uses existing finance/budgets API/UI. Opening commitment is recorded once; no payment or historical approval is replayed.
applicationPlan.phase3: If historical linkage is later confirmed and separately approved, reconcile request and payment departments together with backup and audit. An opening commitment already included must not be incremented again.
applicationPlan.verification: Read-only budget review must reject unassigned purchase payments and mismatched request/payment departments, even when the request itself has been linked.
applicationPlan.currentLimitation: Historical 52M remains disclosed as unassigned; this proposal does not claim complete historical reconciliation or public readiness.

otherDepartments: Use only existing department names and approved amounts. Do not invent departments from role labels or create budgets automatically.
